name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.12.4 progressively broadens one independently verified official Shopify storefront from full visual traits to core traits and category, then ranks recalled products by visual evidence. It canonicalizes DÔEN brand input, keeps new-image context separate from immediate brand corrections, and logs whether official search returned zero products, insufficient visual evidence, rejected candidates, or accepted results. Visual candidates remain conservatively labeled rather than inventing EXACT identity. Deal Concierge reuses stable selected-product identity, current price, inventory, verified deal candidates, optional delivered-price evidence, and bounded price history before returning BUY_NOW, WAIT, or WATCH. Authorized bounded Chrome search remains a user-approved fallback only after eligible API searches return no usable result. Search ranking remains independent of affiliate relationships. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, price history, or sale probability; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
